command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# spawn's task shell drops the image PATH; aarchbio's prefix is /opt/conda, bioconda's x86 /usr/local.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
: > smoke-check.txt; : > archr.log
echo "== staged fixture and script must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c fixture.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the ArchR fixture does not match its pins" | tee -a smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
echo "fixture                      $(wc -l < fixture.sha256 | tr -d ' ') of $(wc -l < fixture.sha256 | tr -d ' ') staged files match their pins" >> smoke-check.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
Rscript archr.R > archr.log 2>&1; RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
echo "Rscript rc $RC in $((T1-T0))s" | tee -a smoke-check.txt
tar -czf archr-logs.tar.gz ArchRLogs QualityControl 2>/dev/null
grep -E "^  (ok|FAIL)" smoke-check.txt | awk '{n[$1]++} END{print "checks: " n["ok"]+0 " ok, " n["FAIL"]+0 " failed"}' | tee -a smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: an ArchR check failed or ArchR died"; tail -40 archr.log; exit 1; }
grep -q "^ArchR OK" smoke-check.txt || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
